facts.conditions: Read from the figure "Derating Curve" (Rating Power Ratio (%) over Ambient Temperature (°C)), not from a table: the solid line falls from 100 % at 50 °C to 33 % at 70 °C, where it ends; only these two end points are stated. The figure prints no point beyond 70 °C; the 33 % level is a printed axis label and is drawn as a dashed line from 0 to 70 °C. Applies to the 0.05 W rating. Says what the maker prints, not what the part reaches in this unvalidated draft instrument.
